continuity: Seven Seas English manga Vol. 1 (2015), official metadata pass
work_or_witness: Official Seven Seas Volume 1 metadata and synopsis
description: A penniless orphan troubled by visions who is sold as a slave to an unnamed inhuman mage and begins a strange new life described as involving magic, fairies, and other fantastical beings.

power_traditions.note: Exact Volume 1 synopsis condition; no cause, magical function, or later ability is inferred.

states_and_transformations.note: Opening premise only; it records coercive context rather than consent or a later resolution.

cosmologies_and_realms.term: fantastical world of magic and fairies
cosmologies_and_realms.note: Publisher's opening setting framing; no real-world folklore equivalence is asserted.

narrative_archetypes.note: Conservative opening premise label based on neglect/abuse context, visions, sale, and entry into magical life.

canon_status: Named individual in the selected official Seven Seas Volume 1 synopsis.

supports: Chise name, orphan status, visions, sale to unnamed inhuman mage, magic, fairies, and fantastical beings

comparison_cautions: Sale into captivity, the unnamed mage's authority, and the broader apprenticeship/betrothal premise involve a severe power imbalance and are not endorsed as romance. Magic and fairies here are source fiction; no real folklore or living tradition is equated with them.
